job.title: Accounts Assistant
job.description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Administrator who enjoys keeping things organised, building positive relationships with customers, and ensuring the finance function runs smoothly?
We're recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a well-established Northampton business in a varied role that combines credit control, purchase ledger, and day-to-day finance administration. You'll be responsible for helping keep accounts up to date, managing customer payments, resolving queries, and supporting the wider finance team with a range of accounting tasks.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a stable, friendly team within a successful business that values reliability, teamwork, and a positive working environment. If you enjoy a busy role where no two days are quite the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Accounts Assistant
Northampton Full Time | Office Based Permanent

The Role
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing and maintaining the sales ledger
  • Chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
  • Building strong relationships with customers to resolve payment queries
  • Reducing aged debt and ensuring accounts remain within agreed terms
  • Processing supplier invoices
  • Supporting the purchase ledger function
  • Reconciling supplier statements
  • Assisting with account reconciliations
  • General finance administration
  • Supporting with year end and month end accounting
  • Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc accounting duties as required
About You
We're looking for someone who:
  • Has previous experience in credit control, accounts receivable, or a similar finance role
  • Enjoys communicating with customers and building positive working relationships
  • Has good attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Is confident managing a busy workload and prioritising tasks effectively
Applications welcomed from Accounts Assistants, Assistant Accountants, Credit Controllers, Finance Assistants, and candidates qualified by experience or studying towards an accounting qualification.
What's on Offer?
  • Stable and successful business with a strong reputation
  • Friendly and supportive finance team
  • Varied role with responsibility from day one
  • Convenient Northampton location with excellent public transport links
  • Full-time, office-based position
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
If you're looking for a busy finance role where you can make a real contribution as part of an experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a flexible, project-based assignment? We are supporting a well-established business in Wellingborough that requires additional support within the finance function to assist with a number of important compliance, audit and process improvement projects.
Reporting to the Finance Director, this is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accountant, whether professionally qualified (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), AAT qualified or QBE. The successful candidate will enjoy investigating and resolving discrepancies, reconciling accounts, bringing records up to date and ensuring financial accuracy.

Temporary Finance Project Accountant (Part Time)
Key Responsibilities
You will be responsible for supporting a range of finance-related projects, including:
  • Reconciling retention payments, identifying amounts paid and outstanding
  • Assisting with a VAT-focused project, reviewing records and supporting compliance activities
  • Supporting a GDPR project, ensuring finance records and processes align with requirements
  • Assisting with risk assessment reviews and documentation
  • Supporting with audit project, gathering information and reconciling financial data
  • Producing accurate reports and findings for senior management
  • Working closely with the Finance Director to deliver project objectives within agreed timescales
About You
We would be pleased to hear from candidates who have:
  • Previous experience within a finance, accounting or audit-related role
  • AAT qualification, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent), or strong finance experience gained through practice (QBE)
  • Excellent reconciliation and analytical skills
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach
  • Good Excel skills
  • The ability to work independently and manage project-based workloads
  • Experience supporting compliance, audit, VAT or process improvement projects would be beneficial
The Opportunity
  • Temporary assignment for approximately 4-8 weeks
  • Flexible part-time hours, between 1 and 3 days per week (within office hours Monday-Friday)
  • Reporting directly to the Finance Director
  • Opportunity to make an immediate impact on several business-critical projects
If you are available for a short-term assignment and enjoy project-based finance work, we would love to hear from you.
If you would like to find out more about this opportunity, please apply and/or contact Julie at Warner Recruitment. We would be delighted to tell you more.

job.title: Credit Controller
job.description:
This is an opportunity to join a long-established, secure business with a strong reputation and a friendly, experienced team. The role will suit someone who enjoys building customer relationships, managing their own workload and being part of a collaborative environment. Warner Recruitment are delighted to be partnering exclusively with Heygates Ltd to recruit a Credit Controller in Bugbrooke Northamptonshire.

Credit Controller
The Role

You'll take responsibility for a varied sales ledger, working closely with customers and colleagues to ensure accounts are managed effectively and payments are collected in a professional and customer-focused manner.

Working with a diverse customer base within the agricultural sector, you'll build strong relationships whilst helping to maintain healthy cash flow and exceptional customer service.

Credit Controller Key Responsibilities
  • Chasing overdue payments and reducing outstanding debt
  • Allocating payments and maintaining the sales ledger
  • Reconciling accounts and resolving queries
  • Setting up new customer accounts
  • Agreeing payment plans where required
  • Processing Direct Debits and cash postings
  • Completing credit checks and assessing customer risk
  • Managing pro forma orders and securing payment
  • Liaising with customers and internal teams
  • Maintaining accurate account records and documentation
About You
We're looking for someone who is:
  • Experienced in Credit Control
  • Confident communicating with customers by phone and email
  • Organised, accurate and detail-focused
  • Proactive and dependable
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
  • Able to build positive relationships and provide excellent customer service
What's on Offer?
  • 24 days holiday
  • Contributory pension (after 3 months)
  • Friendly and supportive team environment
  • Stable, well-established and financially secure employer
  • Varied and engaging workload
  • On-site parking
  • Long-term career stability within a respected local business
Apply Now
If you're looking for a Credit Control role with a successful Northamptonshire employer that values teamwork, customer service and long-term commitment, we'd love to hear from you, for more information contact Julie at Warner Recruitment.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Exclusive & Retained
Heygates is a successful Northamptonshire family business with its head office based in Bugbrooke. Employing over 1,400 people across its operations, the Group is recognised as one of the UK's leading flour milling businesses and is now seeking an experienced Accountant to join its established finance team of 15.
Supplying major food manufacturers, supermarket bakeries and independent craft bakers nationwide, Heygates plays an important role in the British food supply chain and has built a reputation for quality, reliability and exceptional customer service.
Combining strong family values with commercial success, the business offers a stable and supportive working environment where many employees enjoy long and rewarding careers. You'll be joining a friendly, knowledgeable and experienced team with impressive long service across the organisation.

The Role:
Are you an experienced Accountant with a strong background in producing monthly and management accounts, along with clear and meaningful reporting for senior stakeholders?
Whether you hold an ACA, ACC, CIMA or have built your expertise through hands-on experience, we'd love to hear from you.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll work closely with and support the Senior Accountant as part of a friendly, collaborative finance team.

Accountant
Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Preparing and presenting management accounts
  • Producing the Profit & Loss account for the Group’s largest subsidiary, with turnover of approximately £250m
  • Completing Balance Sheet reconciliations
  • Providing financial analysis and insight to support business decision-making
  • Supporting with quarter-end reporting
  • Managing VAT returns and supporting tax compliance
  • Supporting projects, including the implementation of a new fixed asset system
  • Reviewing processes and recommending improvements where appropriate
  • Preparing financial and management reports
  • Coding and processing invoices
  • Approving payment runs
  • Providing systems support and troubleshooting where required
  • Supporting other departments with financial guidance and information
  • Preparing National Statistics reports
The person:
You will be well suited to this role if you are:

  • Confident producing a full set of accounts
  • Strong in accounting principles and practice
  • Proactive, practical and solutions-focused
  • Accurate, organised and detail-focused
  • Structured in your approach to work
  • Confident using Excel
Benefits:
  • Contributory pension
  • 24 days holiday + public holidays
  • Free on-site parking
This is a Warner Exclusive retained role with Warner Recruitment Ltd.

If you would like to find out more about this opportunity, please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment. We would be delighted to tell you more.
